title: All enabled Projects writers are mapped
setup_and_interleaving: Trace every create/update/delete/child/import/bulk path and each adapter at the actual branch.
required_assertion: No unresolved writer in the pilot perimeter; paths and symbols recorded.

title: Decoupled contract graph
setup_and_interleaving: Resolve source/sibling project and public-type graph before change.
required_assertion: Renderer/contracts have no persistence or concrete-owner dependency.

title: Matched cost baseline
setup_and_interleaving: Run selected uncontended/disjoint/hot workloads on isolated DB with source/environment recorded.
required_assertion: Measured costs and missing measurements explicit; no fabricated speedup.

title: Original token survives server reload
setup_and_interleaving: Read A in client, commit B elsewhere, load current entity inside save then submit original A.
required_assertion: B remains; old body cannot use freshly loaded token.

title: Child-only stamp advancement
setup_and_interleaving: Read root editor; update only one child through each enabled writer.
required_assertion: Root edit stamp advances with child commit and old editor conflicts.

title: Coherent aggregate read
setup_and_interleaving: Pause between project and child reads while another transaction changes the aggregate.
required_assertion: Returned stamp/data form one valid snapshot, not mixed observations.

title: Conditional failure rolls back children
setup_and_interleaving: Apply child changes in transaction then make root expected condition fail.
required_assertion: No child/receipt/projection effect commits.

title: Commit succeeds; observer fails
setup_and_interleaving: Commit owner mutation then throw in postcommit observer.
required_assertion: Committed identity/stamp preserved; no retry of primary effect.

title: Commit acknowledgement lost
setup_and_interleaving: Interrupt transport/connection at commit acknowledgement using controlled fault boundary.
required_assertion: Unconfirmed observation resolves by exact operation; no assumed rollback.

title: Dispose failure releases gates
setup_and_interleaving: Inject transaction disposal failure on owned scope with waiting next operation.
required_assertion: Owned process gates release; original/cleanup errors remain distinguishable.

title: Source lease finalization after commit
setup_and_interleaving: Commit then fail source lease disposal/finalization.
required_assertion: No relabelling as rejected; cleanup problem visible with committed evidence.

title: Source-first nested ordering
setup_and_interleaving: Run opposing source/target operations and nested owner participation under controlled barriers.
required_assertion: No cyclic acquisition/self-deadlock; existing authority precedence preserved.

title: Two-process ordinary and governed paths
setup_and_interleaving: Run ordinary and source-authorized writes from separate host processes.
required_assertion: Same declared invariants without relying on process semaphores.

title: Retired enlisted scope
setup_and_interleaving: Use a participant after coordination exits or with foreign physical profile.
required_assertion: Deterministic refusal before owner data effect.

title: Retry taxonomy
setup_and_interleaving: Return domain conflict, serialization failure, deadlock and unknown commit separately.
required_assertion: Only safe technical transaction retries reuse original operation/basis.

title: Bulk update predicate
setup_and_interleaving: Exercise each enabled ExecuteUpdate/raw SQL write to protected state.
required_assertion: Explicit condition and affected rows; aggregate token participates.

title: Cancellation while acquiring multiple gates
setup_and_interleaving: Cancel after first acquisition and before later acquisition succeeds.
required_assertion: All acquired resources released, no operation effect.

title: No parallel enlisted commands
setup_and_interleaving: Exercise/inspect multi-owner participant scheduling on one shared connection.
required_assertion: Bounded awaited sequential participation, no Task.WhenAll database commands.

title: Two editors phase versus name
setup_and_interleaving: Both load A; first adds phase and commits; second saves old full editor with renamed project.
required_assertion: Second conflicts; phase persists; no silent overwrite.

title: Actual agent versus human update
setup_and_interleaving: Governed tool proposal from A waits; human commits B; actual tool dispatch resumes.
required_assertion: Owner rejects stale target; tool receives structured conflict.

title: Missing original stamp
setup_and_interleaving: Call protected update through each public/API-only route without condition.
required_assertion: Known precondition refusal, not null bypass or fresh-stamp refill.

title: Conflicting header and body
setup_and_interleaving: Send mismatched If-Match/body stamp through new contract.
required_assertion: Deterministic documented rejection; no weaker alternate path.

title: Delete and recreate same public ID
setup_and_interleaving: Load old editor; retire project; create new lifetime under same public ID; submit old editor.
required_assertion: New project untouched; lifetime-specific failure.

title: Concurrent duplicate creation
setup_and_interleaving: Send same scoped operation ID concurrently with valid creation admission.
required_assertion: One exact creation/lifetime; both resolve same accepted result.

title: Duplicate after later edit
setup_and_interleaving: Operation A commits; B changes target; repeat A with same ID/body.
required_assertion: Return A receipt, not fresh-content conflict and not reapply A.

title: Same ID different intention
setup_and_interleaving: Reuse ID with changed target/body/basis/expected stamp.
required_assertion: Semantic identity mismatch; no effect.

title: Pending duplicate lookup
setup_and_interleaving: Hold first transaction active; second request cannot yet see receipt.
required_assertion: No new independent effect; protocol handles pending/not-visible outcome.

title: Receipt disclosure revoked
setup_and_interleaving: Commit as authorized actor then revoke access before result lookup.
required_assertion: No unauthorized result fields disclosed; effect is not replayed.

title: Root-child-receipt atomic rollback
setup_and_interleaving: Fail at each save step before commit.
required_assertion: Either all declared records commit or none; no lying success receipt.

title: Conflict keeps draft/EditContext
setup_and_interleaving: Return actual owner conflict after user typed multiple fields.
required_assertion: Draft and validation preserved; current state displayed separately.

title: Typing during save
setup_and_interleaving: Freeze S; user changes L; accepted normalized C returns.
required_assertion: Compare S vs L, retain new typing and adopt accepted untouched fields/stamp.

title: A to B to A late callback
setup_and_interleaving: Start operation/read for A1, switch B then new A2, finish A1.
required_assertion: Old completion cannot alter A2, reopen dialog or reset busy state.

title: Save button plus Enter
setup_and_interleaving: Dispatch both events in same active editor lifetime.
required_assertion: One admitted submission; successor editor is not blocked by retired lifetime.

title: Committed but read-back fails
setup_and_interleaving: Owner commit succeeds, accepted result retained, follow-up read throws.
required_assertion: Visible saved-with-warning; retry reads only.

title: Owner-generated child IDs
setup_and_interleaving: Create local rows, receive durable IDs, type again and save.
required_assertion: Rows retain correct identity; no delete/recreate duplication.

title: Old projection runs after new save
setup_and_interleaving: Control A/B projection order so older work would execute last.
required_assertion: Final search reflects current state or correct ordered cursor.

title: Crash between source and projection work
setup_and_interleaving: Terminate after source acceptance at each selected projection protocol boundary.
required_assertion: Same-transaction rollback/commit or durable rebuild recovery; no lost required work.

title: Delayed projection after recreate
setup_and_interleaving: Queue old lifetime index work; delete/recreate; deliver old work.
required_assertion: No revival/overwrite of new incarnation.

title: Import source stamps/history
setup_and_interleaving: Import retained v2/v3 project/history into target profile.
required_assertion: New local live tokens; imported approvals/receipts/reservations inert.

title: Destructive restore and future client
setup_and_interleaving: Restore older dataset then submit pre-restore-future client operation.
required_assertion: Activation namespace/fence rejects invalid old authority/replay.

title: Ordinary restart preserves receipts
setup_and_interleaving: Commit and restart host without destructive data change; retry original operation.
required_assertion: Original durable operation remains reconcilable; no gratuitous epoch reset.

title: Explicit missing versus create read
setup_and_interleaving: Request edit for missing existing project then deliberate create separately.
required_assertion: No accidental rebind to blank create; documented compatibility behavior.

title: Two real editors end to end
setup_and_interleaving: Use actual Web sessions over PG for phase/name race and conflict resolution.
required_assertion: UI and persisted data agree; original text retained and final new write conditional.

title: Renderer dependency and sandbox
setup_and_interleaving: Build actual renderer/sandbox with evaluated graph after token contract change.
required_assertion: No owner persistence/MAF/Web implementation imported.

title: Fresh saves/creates/authorized updates
setup_and_interleaving: Run matching preconditions and valid creation/source admissions.
required_assertion: Legitimate work succeeds; safety not implemented by rejecting everything.

title: Independent scalar three-way merge
setup_and_interleaving: B/L/C vary independently for allowed fields.
required_assertion: Only permitted nonconflicting values merge; resulting invariants validated.

title: Third writer during conflict resolution
setup_and_interleaving: Show C, prepare merge, commit D before resolved save.
required_assertion: Resolved save conflicts again rather than forcing overwrite.

title: Cross-field invalid merge
setup_and_interleaving: Individually different fields together break domain invariant.
required_assertion: Owner refuses invalid result despite nonoverlapping changed fields.

title: Explicit add/remove/reorder
setup_and_interleaving: Interleave two narrow collection intentions with original relevant preconditions.
required_assertion: Stable identities and declared order; no implicit list deletion.

title: Foreign/duplicate/unknown child ID
setup_and_interleaving: Submit mixed IDs including another project's child and duplicate persisted ID.
required_assertion: Deterministic safe rejection; no mutation or silent recreation.

title: Normalization/default rows/no-op
setup_and_interleaving: Exercise trim/UTC/blank options/default categories and equal accepted content.
required_assertion: Documented stamp/UpdatedAt/activity/receipt behavior; no hidden extra rows.

title: Value A to B to A
setup_and_interleaving: Change relevant value twice before old proposal returns.
required_assertion: Generation-sensitive policy detects obsolete observation; value-based exceptions explicit.

title: Objective changes during reasoning
setup_and_interleaving: Capture planning basis; modify objective; publish previously prepared task batch.
required_assertion: StaleDecisionBasis-style rejection, no task effects.

title: Membership phantom
setup_and_interleaving: Read all matching tasks including an empty set; another writer inserts/reassigns matching task.
required_assertion: Scope witness invalidates proposal even if original row tokens unchanged.

title: Model omits mandatory input
setup_and_interleaving: Try publishing proposal with no required objective/membership basis.
required_assertion: Trusted runtime/owner refuses; model cannot choose an empty validation set.

title: Refresh stamp under old approval
setup_and_interleaving: Attach current tokens to old proposal/approval without new allowed decision.
required_assertion: Binding mismatch or stale basis refusal; no effect.

title: Source edit during publication
setup_and_interleaving: Pause after protected source validation; competing source writer attempts change. Also establish a Serializable snapshot before waiting for a source advisory gate, then let its previous owner commit a source update.
required_assertion: Declared publication freshness/exclusion holds; no pre-wait historical snapshot is mistaken for the source state after gate acquisition. Fresh locking read, rejection or whole-attempt retry follows the chosen protocol.

title: Revocation before actual effect
setup_and_interleaving: Capture valid grant/claim, revoke before owner commit, finish operation.
required_assertion: Owner current-authority check rejects exact attempt.

title: Retired worker ignores cancellation
setup_and_interleaving: Take over/advance attempt generation, then allow old worker to publish.
required_assertion: Old generation rejected at owner despite active task.

title: Manual edit keeping automation vs pin
setup_and_interleaving: Perform each explicit override/takeover policy action.
required_assertion: Future automation follows chosen mandate; no unconditional human/agent precedence.

title: Bounded semantic replans
setup_and_interleaving: Continuously invalidate material basis during successive attempts.
required_assertion: Escalation after agreed limit; no infinite compute/token loop.

title: Unrelated updates do not invalidate
setup_and_interleaving: Append logs/chat while planning material objective/task facts.
required_assertion: Basis remains valid unless those facts are actual declared dependencies.

title: Oversized basis and truncated input
setup_and_interleaving: Submit more required facts than supported, or an unacknowledged truncated query.
required_assertion: Explicit bounded rejection/staged contract; never successful incomplete validation.

title: Actual governed planning positive/negative
setup_and_interleaving: Run actual read/propose/approve/owner tool pipeline with valid and stale basis.
required_assertion: Fresh proposal succeeds, invalid proposal has no effects and structured recovery.

title: Opposing graph moves/cycle
setup_and_interleaving: Concurrently reconnect nodes/projects so individually plausible moves would form a cycle.
required_assertion: Final graph invariant holds under complete owner guard set.

title: Task assignment/cost/execution preservation
setup_and_interleaving: Interleave title, assignee and execution/schedule changes through existing owners.
required_assertion: Existing expected-state, assignment and pricing semantics not weakened.

title: Multi-owner batch rollback
setup_and_interleaving: Fail a selected owner participant after another staged change on shared transaction.
required_assertion: Declared same-DB atomic set rolls back; no independent hidden commit.

title: Conversation append versus definition edit
setup_and_interleaving: Append independent replies and concurrently edit definition where allowed.
required_assertion: Append not lost through parent snapshot; own request dedupe/order preserved.

title: CRM conflict privacy
setup_and_interleaving: Conflict affects a sensitive CRM field unreadable to caller.
required_assertion: Safe conflict detail without rate/personal-data disclosure.

title: Owner adoption graph guard
setup_and_interleaving: Introduce selected owner data-only contract and actual renderer adapter.
required_assertion: No global AppDbContext or foreign owner persistence access.

title: Maintenance path participation
setup_and_interleaving: Run explicit setup/import and ordinary update to same protected data through documented boundaries.
required_assertion: Maintenance provenance/conditions explicit; production bypass absent.

title: External file edit between read/replace
setup_and_interleaving: Change file outside app after expected revision capture and before driver replace.
required_assertion: Actual driver guarantee observed; unsupported strict CAS is explicit.

title: Provider accepts then timeout
setup_and_interleaving: Provider records effect but response is lost; delivery worker resumes.
required_assertion: Provider-specific identity resolves result; no unsafe resend.

title: Provider without dedupe/lookup
setup_and_interleaving: Interrupt uncertain delivery for a provider lacking safe retry protocol.
required_assertion: Manual/explicit recovery, no claim of automatic exactly-once effect.

title: Stale compensation after human change
setup_and_interleaving: Create/modify through operation A, then human adds related work; compensate A.
required_assertion: Narrow guarded compensation refuses destructive stale undo.

title: Outbox duplicate/reorder/poison
setup_and_interleaving: Deliver duplicate and reversed jobs; one job fails repeatedly.
required_assertion: Latest valid projection preserved; bounded retries and unrelated work progress.

title: Revocation overlapping external dispatch
setup_and_interleaving: Revoke during provider delivery at specified fence boundary.
required_assertion: Report actual supported ordering/uncertainty, not fictional rollback.

title: Receipt retention versus checkpoint replay
setup_and_interleaving: Expire full details while supported replay/checkpoint still exists.
required_assertion: Compact evidence or expiry refusal prevents duplicate effect.

title: Partial staged batch
setup_and_interleaving: Fail after some externally committed items in explicitly staged operation.
required_assertion: Exact per-item outcomes, no atomic-success claim or whole-batch blind replay.

title: Resume pinned definition after live edit
setup_and_interleaving: Admit run on immutable definition; edit current definition; resume computation.
required_assertion: Pinned execution remains distinct; publication into current target separately checked.

title: Legacy checkpoint missing required basis
setup_and_interleaving: Load historical saved run/approval without newly required provenance.
required_assertion: Readable history or explicit readmission, never fabricated current basis.

title: Replay stored denial
setup_and_interleaving: Resume checkpoint containing no-effect policy/source denial.
required_assertion: No conversion into an executing effect or unauthorized disclosure.

title: Process claim transfer late write
setup_and_interleaving: Advance current claim and release delayed old attempt into owner write.
required_assertion: Old attempt fenced with no effects; new valid attempt succeeds.

title: Real workflow/process operator journey
setup_and_interleaving: Launch small real workflow/process, edit relevant target, resolve blocked publication through UI.
required_assertion: Owner effects and operator outcome agree; no approval/retry bypass.

title: Saved protocol downgrade
setup_and_interleaving: Attempt older writer against new saved basis/approval/receipt protocol during planned rehearsal.
required_assertion: Admission/version policy prevents unsafe downgrade.

title: Mixed-version deployment rehearsal
setup_and_interleaving: Activate protected owner while a deliberately incompatible caller/worker attempts update.
required_assertion: Incompatible writer refused; safe pause/forward repair path.

title: Cross-platform canonical gates
setup_and_interleaving: Run current documented required lanes at named closure checkpoint with exact discovery.
required_assertion: Actual pass/fail/skip evidence per platform, no inferred green.

title: Matched final performance comparison
setup_and_interleaving: Repeat declared workload register on current final source and baseline conditions.
required_assertion: Budgets/exception decisions supported by counts and distributions.

title: Metrics cardinality and secret redaction
setup_and_interleaving: Generate conflicts/receipts/bases containing sensitive values and many IDs.
required_assertion: Useful bounded metrics and safe logs; no secret-bearing payloads.

title: Complete protected perimeter closure
setup_and_interleaving: Reconcile current callers, inventory, migrations, tests and residual risks after final merge drift.
required_assertion: Zero undocumented enabled bypasses in advertised coverage.

title: Missed notification cannot admit stale write
setup_and_interleaving: Drop every UI/cache invalidation event while another writer changes the target.
required_assertion: Original expected condition still rejects stale update.

title: Read-back newer than original commit
setup_and_interleaving: A commits; B commits before A client reads current state.
required_assertion: Original accepted receipt and later current snapshot are labelled and reconciled separately.

title: Dynamic guard expansion
setup_and_interleaving: Discover an additional dependency after taking initial ordered guards.
required_assertion: Abort/replan or explicit bounded rejection; no unsafe late lock-order inversion.

title: Equal target but stale approved basis
setup_and_interleaving: Make proposed target values equal current while changing a material source/mandate.
required_assertion: No-op shortcut cannot authorize obsolete proposal.

title: Edit stamp versus dashboard ETag
setup_and_interleaving: Change dashboard-only derived data while definition is unchanged.
required_assertion: Dedicated edit token contract is not falsely advertised as strong validator of full dashboard.

title: Operation namespace across profiles
setup_and_interleaving: Use same public operation/target IDs in separate allowed dataset namespaces.
required_assertion: No false replay or disclosure across profiles/epochs.
